'''Spiced leathermeat''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] prepared and eaten by members of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture. One of the many commercial stalls that were set up along [[Chortav Meshurkaane]] on [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe's]] market days sold packets of [[Spice/Legends|spiced]] leathermeat. The veteran Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] purchased a packet from the vendor during a trip to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Shortly thereafter, Skirata stopped at the nearby stone balustrade that overlooked the [[Kelita River]] to unwrap and eat a portion of the leathermeat he'd obtained.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spiced leathermeat was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the fifth entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' novel series]] written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], published [[October 27]], [[2009]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
